ownerDirection: Continue usable frontend slices: improve Agent/channel experience or connect Search/Activity. This batch connects read-only discovery and Agent name filtering.

implementation.search: Authenticated message search, scope all/channel/direct/thread, 20-row replacing pages, previous/next, query/filter URL recovery, repeated search resets to page 1. Existing server keyword matching and recent order retained.
implementation.activity: Server activity.list, all/unread/mentions filters, bounded pages and explicit refresh. Unread values are canonical API data; viewing never marks read automatically.
implementation.context: Exact message.context result plus bounded context/root, deduplicated and chronological; existing RoomSession supplies member names; official MessageItem read-only rendering. Open parent conversation at latest messages and return to saved query.
implementation.agent: Role/instance display-name filter, also matching the instance channel name; no business-state change.
implementation.owners: Existing SDK / Kernel ACL, cursors, activity and RoomSession. No protocol, backend handler, model prompt, scheduler or memory changes.
implementation.reuse: Unchanged official PanelHeader/MessageItem and raft-ui SearchShell/Results/EntityResult/ActivityInboxPanel/Dialog. Local page composition references MessageSearchPage/ThreadsInbox, not byte-exact reuse of whole pages.

verification.tdd: New browser test first failed on missing search input. Same-query pagination reset reproduced before fix. Fault scenarios cover delayed old responses, search failure and denied context; no weakening of content/identity checks.
verification.isolatedBrowser: browser.json: desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844 DPR1, real temporary Core/fake discovery only. Exact API search/activity IDs, bounded pagination, exact context, scope, refresh, open/back, late-read suppression, clear/retry, Agent filter, no implicit activity.mark; all existing flows retained.
verification.fullCheck: npm run check exited 1: 3208 passed, 22 opt-in skipped; untouched instance-prewarm.test.ts recovery scenario returned skipped instead of started. Failed assertion did not print the skip reason; root cause not established.
verification.targetedRepeat: Unmodified entire instance-prewarm.test.ts subsequently passed 22/22. This is not evidence that the original failure is eliminated.
verification.remainingChecks: Console 63, browser policy 15, efficiency unit 558 and official source/projection 15 passed separately after the full-check short circuit.
verification.build: Typechecked channel build and final clean-commit build:web:workbench passed; two-size isolated browser gate passed after the title fix. Initial product build also passed the full isolated gate; final actual product checked by page.json.
verification.production: page.json: real search IDs and exact context, activity IDs, query reload, result-row width, existing 42 Roles / 68 instances, members, channel/private history and console verified at 1440x1000 and 390x844 DPR1. No formal business writes or paid calls.
verification.layoutRegression: Real mobile data exposed 13 overflowing title rows. Long-name fixture regression failed before reusing official SearchEntityResultHeader, then the full browser gate and real-page row-width assertions passed. No source CSS override.

limits: Message search only; no entity search or advanced author/date filters. Existing server multi-keyword matching retained.
Activity is read-only: mark-read/done, follow/unfollow and mute controls not ported.
Context has no thread composer, attachment operations or live subscription; opening parent is a latest-message view, not an anchored jump.
Query/scope survive URL reload; result page number returns to first page after remount.
The unrelated full-suite prewarm failure remains visible and unexplained.
